'''Speral''' is an assistant to the grain merchants of [[So Habor]].

==Activities==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]] come to So Habor to purchase supplies, Speral presents samples of the grains the merchants have to offer.{{ref/book|10|26}}
